parameters.query: SELECT bgc.set_import($1, jsonb_build_object('step', 'Getting game details and box art', 'games', $2::int, 'expansions', $3::int)) AS s
SELECT bgc.set_import($1, jsonb_build_object('step', 'Reading your plays')) AS s
SELECT bgc.set_import($1, jsonb_build_object('state', 'done', 'step', 'Done', 'added', $2::int, 'plays', $3::int, 'players', $4::int, 'finished', at.iso(now()))) AS s

SELECT x -> 'records' AS records, x ->> 'id' AS id, x ->> 'createdTime' AS "createdTime", x -> 'fields' AS fields, (x ->> 'deleted')::boolean AS deleted FROM (SELECT at.request($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5) AS x) q
